eliminations.All32: Diagnostic only; no stable coarse recovery. Not eligible as default accelerated winner.
eliminations.L28: No reliable recovery trend at L24; not tested.
eliminations.all-none-L24: Same GQA and lower VQA versus all-none-L20.
eliminations.qsa-L24: Lower GQA and equal VQA versus qsa-L20; deeper cost.
eliminations.qsa-both: Lower GQA/VQA versus qsa-decode on complete DEV.
eliminations.repeat-after-instruction: Same original-Native GQA score and lower VQA than All/decode/L20, with added text/KV cost.
eliminations.repeat-before-instruction: Lower GQA and VQA point scores than All/decode/L20, with added text/KV cost.

rule: Quality-first worst ORIGINAL Native dataset loss; ties within 0.25pp resolved using paired E2E then KV. No candidate selection on FINAL.
